newsitem.title: USA: Jakks Pacific files for secondary offer.
newsitem.headline: Jakks Pacific files for secondary offer.

text.p: JAKKS Pacific Inc said it has filed a registration statement for a secondary offering of 2.4 million shares of common stock.
The offering will be managed by Cruttenden Roth. Two million shares will be offered by the company, 400,000 shares to be offered by certain selling shareholders.
JAKKS and selling shareholders have granted the underwriter an option, exercisable within 45 days of the closing, to buy up to 360,000 additional shares.
Proceeds will be used for company acquisitions, product acquisitions, new licenses, product expansion and the repayment of short-term debt.
